issues.issue: Marked false, but the approval is based on hematologic/cytogenetic response rates with the label stating 'There are no controlled trials demonstrating a clinical benefit, such as ... increased survival' plus a confirmatory 24-month follow-up PMC for CA-180-015 — hallmarks of accelerated approval that this card fails to capture.
The '≥10%' threshold number is not contained in any citation quote; cosmetic uncited number since the actual AE percentages (50,49,40,39) are all cited.
